headline: China Targets Offshore Trusts with New Retroactive Taxes Amid Fiscal Strains
summary: China implemented a 20 percent tax on offshore trust assets and distributions, backdated to January 1, as authorities seek new funding sources to ease fiscal pressures.
why: Increasing tax enforcement and targeting offshore wealth reflect Beijing's broader push to boost fiscal revenues and enforce tax compliance.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Tighter offshore asset taxation helps local government finances but may weigh on investor confidence.
